questions.question: If 15 January 2019 was a Tuesday, then what day of the week was it on 29 January 2020?
questions.solution:
Given: **15 January 2019** was Tuesday.

Now,

2019 to 2020 = 1 Year (1 Ordinary Year).

And, In 1 Year = 1 Ordinary Year.

then, 15 January 2020 will be Tuesday + 1 = Wednesday.

Now, the number of days between 15 January 2020 to 29 January 2020

= 14 days.

= 14 days → 14/7 = 2 weeks and 0 odd day.

So, **29 January 2020** will be Wednesday .

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
72 is related to 96 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 66 is related to 88. Which of the following numbers is related to 104 using the same logic?

(NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding / subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: 1st number + (1st number ÷ 3) = 2nd number.

Now,

For, 72 : 96

⇒ 72 + (72 ÷ 3)

= 72 + 24 = 96.

For, 66 : 88

⇒ 66 + (66 ÷ 3) 

= 66 + 22 = 88.

Similarly, for 78 ∶ 104

**⇒ 78 + (78 ÷ 3) = 104**

⇒ 78 + 26 = 104.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question:
Three statements are followed by conclusions numbered I, II. You have to consider these statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts. Decide which of the given conclusions logically follow/s from the given statement.

**Statements:**

All paints are houses.

All houses are wood.

Some streets are wood.

**Conclusion (I): **Some streets are houses.

**Conclusion (II):** All paints are wood.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8fb2d960ef2c28b7ccf1716a3a48d3054d658699d81ae9d74afc9992f5db4542.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some streets are houses → **Does not** follow (As all paints are houses, all houses are wood and some streets are wood. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

II. All paints are wood → Follow (As all paints are houses and all houses are wood. So, as whole paints comes in houses which whole comes in wood therefore it is true)

∴ Here, Only conclusion (II) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "**Only conclusion (II) follows**"

questions.question: If 3 April 1996 was Wednesday, then what was the day of the week on 7 April 2001?
questions.solution: Given: **3 April 1996** was Wednesday. Now, 1996 to 2001 = 5 Years (4 Ordinary Year and 1 Leap Year). And, In 5 Years = 1 Leap year and 4 Ordinary Year. So, 1 Leap Year has 2 odd days, And, 4 Ordinary Year has 4 odd days.
